research_question: At what one-cell period does eager-dual miss the D80 deadline, and does the transactional external path preserve deadline, radio correctness, and positive completed AI work there?

decision_at_stake.diagnostic_pass: If at least one preregistered period meets all crossover, radio, AI, and safety conditions in both opposite-order rounds, prioritize N2 and the full combined-baseline implementation at that period; still do not claim novelty from eager alone.
decision_at_stake.diagnostic_fail: If no period meets all conditions, do not add seeds or relax the contract; implement a comparable multicell transactional path before judging the complete N1 grid. If that full grid also fails, pursue the N3 state-transition measurement claim.

if_both_outcomes_lead_to_same_action: Cancel this diagnostic if both outcomes would leave the next implementation priority unchanged.
comparison_role: N1 operating-point diagnostic; eager-dual and conventional-only are ablations, not the strongest realistic opponent.
strongest_realistic_opponent: Online channel gate plus queue-aware endpoint choice plus fixed recovery reservation plus bounded AI, with the same safety contract and GPU budget; specified in docs/current/SOFTWALL_STRONG_BASELINE_SPEC_KO.md but not implemented in Confirm51.

measurement_sources.external_safety: external controller JSON:endpoint_timeouts, nrx_bound_violations, conv_bound_violations, duplicate_commits, fallback_not_started, fallback_start_late_gt_1ms, runtime_metrics, records[*].fallback_actual_start_ns

diagnostic_pass_criteria.external_radio_correctness_each_round: paired correct fraction difference versus eager no less than -0.25 percentage points; report exact pair counts

evidence_grade: C for a single period; B only if the same preregistered crossover repeats in both opposite-order rounds. Neither grade proves superiority over the combined baseline or hard worst-case isolation.
interpretation_limits: The transactional controller supports one cell and one endpoint. P<42 ms cannot fit a 40 ms AI host budget plus 2 ms guard between releases; a zero-AI crossover is a failed user-objective gate. This diagnostic cannot decide the full 1/2/4/8-cell N1 grid. All three policies must be interpreted under the same synthetic SNR trace, not as a production slot guarantee.
